records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2022
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 13% to $520.4 million in 2022 from $460.4 million in 2021.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2022
records.text: We accounted for the contingent consideration using fair value and established a liability for the future earn-out payment based on an estimation of revenue attributable to perpetual licenses and subscription licenses over the 2020 calendar year.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2022
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 62%, 61% and 64% of our revenue in 2022, 2021 and 2020, respectively.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2022
records.text: Our net income attributable to common stockholders increased $2.0 million and $8.1 million during the three and twelve months ended December 31, 2022, respectively, as a result of adopting ASU 2020-06 due to no longer recording non-cash interest expense related to the amortization of the debt discount associated with the previous equity component of the convertible senior notes.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2022
records.text: For 2022, cash flows from operating activities were $56.9 million, compared to $103.2 million for 2021.
